learning_outcomes.text: Face the choice of composite materials and production technologies according to their application.
Characterize the mechanical behavior of composite materials and of components made with them.
Check the quality of the composite materials and the components made with them.
Design components made of composite materials.
Have a general vision on the life cycle management of composite materials in the circular economy.

syllabus_topics: Properties of the individual constituents (Fiber and Matrix)
Matlab program for calculating in-plane and flexural stiffness of flat laminates
Numerical modeling of mechanical behavior of composite laminate by Finite Element Method (FEM) with layered shell and solid elements
Analysis of critical aspects in composite materials: shear behavior, free edge effects and open hole
Design and optimization of a composite component of industrial interest
Experimental validation of the composite component
teaching_methods: Computer lab activities for numerical simulation
Review of projects carried out in groups
Lamination activities at university laboratories and involved companies
Health and safety training (General Training Course Module 1 and High-Risk Training Course Module 3 via e-learning)

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination (discussion of Matlab code and related applied theory)
Oral examination (presentation on design and testing of the component developed by the team)

bibliography: Mechanics of Fibrous Composites, Carl T. Herakovich, Wiley (1998).
Composite Materials Design and Applications, Daniel Gay, CRC Press (2015).
Introduction to Composite Materials Design, Ever J. Barbero, CRC Press (2017).
institution: Università Di Bologna - Alma Mater Studiorum — Laurea Magistrale Ingegneria meccanica
